$description: Approved asset manifest. Claude references images ONLY from this list, never invents or substitutes stock, and never shows a placeholder when a committed file exists. A file sitting in assets/ that is NOT listed here is not selectable, and that is intentional.

$labeling.key: Deterministic id. One entry per approved asset, so the wrong file cannot be picked.
$labeling.path: In-repo committed file. Render from it directly.
$labeling.rights: Ownership plus any release note. Unclear rights means NOT approved for publishing.

$rules.size: Every committed image must be under 5 MB. Some design tools silently drop larger files on sync. For opaque photographic assets, keep full resolution and re-encode as JPEG q=96 4:4:4 rather than downscaling. Anything with transparency stays PNG.
$rules.no_css_gradients: Never substitute a CSS gradient for a texture. Place a real file. A CSS gradient has no grain and no optical break and reads as generic immediately.
$rules.no_recolor: Approved colour variants are separate real files. Never invert, filter, or recolour a logo to make one.
$rules.rights: Unclear rights means NOT approved. Anything with unverified provenance is comps-only until a human confirms it. A filename is not provenance.

usage.$rule: Match the piece's format first, then the slot. Use ONLY an asset listed for that slot. If nothing fits, show a labeled slot and flag it.

northlight-mark-ink.notes: For paper, white, and sand grounds. SVG, so there is no maximum placement size.
northlight-mark-ink.rights: Sample asset, MIT with this template. Replace with yours.

northlight-mark-white.notes: For texture, ink, and harbour grounds.
northlight-mark-white.rights: Sample asset, MIT with this template. Replace with yours.

texture-dawn-01.alt: Cool blue falling into a warm horizon of light, fine grain
texture-dawn-01.notes: The warm default. Card grounds and social panels.
texture-dawn-01.rights: Generated for this template, MIT. Replace with yours.

texture-dusk-02.alt: Deep violet-slate with a soft light source upper left, fine grain
texture-dusk-02.notes: The cooler alternate. Use where the piece should feel serious rather than warm.
texture-dusk-02.rights: Generated for this template, MIT. Replace with yours.

photos.$description: Empty by design. Add your own, with a rights note on every entry. Anything whose provenance you cannot state is comps-only.
